claims.statement: 1953-10 서울기록원 5,500호 재건주택 계획과 1954 UN Yearbook 9,000~9,500호 계획은 동일 시점·동일 사업범위의 확정 준공 실적이다
claims.conclusion: Both are plan figures with differing dates/scope; 1953 Oct national 2-year earthen-block plan 5,500 (2,500 metro +3,000 provincial); 1954 UN programme 9,000-9,500; not proof of conflicting completed-unit counts. Need project amendment annex. A/2750 §70 original says ~5,000 permanent dwellings in 1953 joint programme, including 2,500 Seoul; Seoul Archives later says 5,500 earth-block plan. Same-year 500-unit gap now explicit but type/revision unknown.
claims.limitation: No presidential direct order inferred; independent family counted only if provenance distinct.

correction_history.reason: Different time/scope and photographic 1953 vs treaty 1954 show conflation rather than two equally supported opposing historical facts; preserve provenance.
Original UNKRA A/2750 accessed: 1953 plan ~5000 vs Seoul Archives ~5500, original type/time denominator to verify; 1954 9000-9500 explicitly combined FY53+FY54 plan.

claims.statement: 1953-12 안암동 재건주택 49호 완공을 UN 1954-09-01 서울 330호 완공과 중복 없이 합산할 수 있다
claims.conclusion: Seoul Archives says 49 Anam completed December 1953; UN Yearbook 330 Seoul completed by Sep 1954. Likely Anam included in cumulative count, not proven. Require district acceptance lists before addition. A/2750 §70 says 1953 Seoul 106 completed out of 210 starts, by Aug1954 330 completed; Anam49 (Dec1953) may be subset of 106 but cannot confirm without district list.

claims.conclusion: Operative paragraphs 3 and 5 urge payment of existing pledges and new pledges, which contradicts full-payment inference. Do not infer aid arrival from resolution.

claims.conclusion: Retrospective official description gives standard 9-pyeong cost and 10-year amortization and ordered eligibility; household contract and exception ledger missing.

claims.statement: 1950 UNGA 410(V) vested UNKRA local-currency sale proceeds directly in the Korean president's discretionary fund
claims.conclusion: B§9 requires local-currency proceeds paid into account controlled by UN Agent General, use after UNCURK consultation and Advisory Committee agreement. Korean executive control cannot be inferred. Implementation exceptions still need treaty/ledger.

claims.statement: UNGA 725(VIII) in 1953 approved a fully funded UNKRA programme through 1955
claims.conclusion: §2 approves programme periods 1953-07~1955-07 subject to Agent General/Advisory Committee consultation; §3 explicitly says sufficient funds are unavailable. Approval is not disbursement.

claims.statement: 1954 Korean counterpart fund special-account law automatically governed every UNKRA local-currency proceeds account
claims.conclusion: UNGA 410(V) B§9 specifies UN Agent General control over proceeds from UN programme sales; Korean law 311 scope and 1954 bilateral treaty original not inspected. Must not merge accounts without original legal reconciliation. A/2750 §7(4) describes distinct ROK-created UNKRA counterpart fund requiring Agent General approval and UNKRA Aid Goods Collection Account requiring joint agreement. Still no evidence that Korean general counterpart law311 governs these accounts.

claims.statement: 1953 UNKRA 재건주택 계획이 5,500호로 확정되어 모든 자료에 동일하게 기록된다
claims.conclusion: A/2750 §70 primary reports approximately 5,000 permanent houses, Seoul area 2,500; Seoul Archives later exhibition says 5,500 earth-block dwellings, Seoul 2,500. Difference 500 may be housing type or later revision, original allocation ledger needed.

claims.statement: 1954-05-31 한-UNKRA 협정은 원조물자 현지통화 수입금에 대해 한국 정부 단독 집행권을 부여했다
claims.conclusion: A/2750 §7(4) states UNKRA counterpart fund hwan spending only with Agent General approval, Aid Goods Collection Account expenditures by ROK-UNKRA agreement. Direct contradiction of unilateral-discretion inference.

claims.statement: 1953년 서울 UNKRA 주택사업은 안암동 49호만 완공했으며 그 외 준공이 없다
claims.conclusion: A/2750 §70 says 210 Seoul homes started in 1953 and 106 completed; Seoul Archives says 49 Anam completed Dec 1953, subset status likely but not proven.

claims.statement: 1954년 서울 주택건설 지연은 국제기구의 해외자금 부족만으로 설명된다
claims.conclusion: A/2750 §70 specifically cites Korean Housing Administration shortage of local currency for local labour/material and delayed September supplementary budget, plus import delivery delays; multi-causal explanation.

claims.statement: 1954 동래 상이군인 재활시설은 350명 완공·수용 실적이 확인된다
claims.conclusion: A/2750 §21 states future capacity 300-350, some buildings renovated and 1-6 month training already under way; planned full capacity not achieved count.

claims.statement: 1954년 UNKRA 중소기업 대출기금 승인액은 지급액과 동일하다
claims.conclusion: A/2750 §45 says Loan Board approved $441,500 and 79m hwan by Sep1954; no individual disbursement ledger. Fund capital $15m +230m hwan separate from approvals.

claims.statement: UNKRA와 KCAC/CRIK는 1954년 한국 내 같은 업무를 동일한 명령체계로 집행했다
claims.conclusion: A/2750 introduction footnote distinguishes UNKRA long-term power/industry/mining/irrigation/education/housing and KCAC/CRIK health, relief, food, transport, with exceptions; combined economic coordination not identical implementing chain.

claims.statement: 1954 UNKRA 부록II 2,384건은 완공 사업 2,384건을 뜻한다
claims.conclusion: A/2750 Annex II labels summary of site locations of FY1953/54 UNKRA projects, not certified completed projects; table OCR alignment unreliable for row figures.

claims.statement: 1954 UNCURK A/2810은 UNKRA A/2750의 모든 사업 실적을 독립적으로 재검증·확인했다
claims.conclusion: UNCURK A/2810 says only A/2750 raises no new point beyond its earlier A/2711 paras89-136; not item-by-item independent certification. Original A/2711 paras89-136 comparison pending.

claims.statement: 1954 유엔 토론에서 UNKRA가 산업재건을 전혀 하지 않았다는 소련 주장에는 반박자료가 없었다
claims.conclusion: Morozov (USSR) SR340 §35-36 alleged aid favored rearmament, little reconstruction; Spender (Australia) SR341 §1-5 rebutted; UNKRA A/2750 §41/45/70 records textile, loan and housing activities. Whether individual projects met their stated purposes requires external audits. Preserve political assertions as attributed, not factual verdict.

claims.statement: 1954 유엔 제2위원회에서 UNKRA 원조 결의는 전원 만장일치로 채택되었다
claims.conclusion: A/C.2/L.254 and Add.1 committee draft adopted 38 votes to 5; paragraph1 separately 35 to5 with3 abstentions. Not unanimous; do not confuse committee vote with later UNGA 828(IX) plenary.

claims.statement: 1954 유엔 총회 대표들의 원조 찬성표는 해당 국가의 추가 기여금 확약을 뜻한다
claims.conclusion: Ethiopia, Peru and Chile representatives explicitly distinguish approving UNKRA resolution from promising further contribution; separate voting and pledges.

claims.statement: 1954년 UNKRA 누적 1억2300만달러는 1954-09-01까지 한국에 현물로 도착한 금액이다
claims.conclusion: Coulter in Dec10 committee says $123m received and spent/obligated/in process; Spender says received, mostly spent or obligated. Different date and accounting categories from A/2750 Sep1954 delivered goods. Do not substitute for landed-goods figure.

claims.statement: 소련대표 모로조프의 1954 남북한 경제지표 비교는 독립 검증된 통계 사실이다
claims.conclusion: SR340 §31-36 records A.P. Morozov's partisan claims on DPRK production and ROK employment. Need independent DPRK, ROK, Soviet/US statistical series before accepting numerical comparisons.

claims.statement: 1953년 UNKRA 감사보고의 5,181만달러 약정액은 같은 해 실제 지급액이다
claims.conclusion: Board of Auditors §5: obligations $51,817,570, actual payments $26,418,878, unliquidated obligations $25,398,692; categories cannot be conflated.

claims.statement: 1953 UNKRA 회계가 무조건부 감사적정을 받았으므로 모든 개별 사업 실물이 준공되었다
claims.conclusion: Auditors certify financial statements without qualification, not physical completion; $5,139,683 obligations were procurement actions with some contracts not finalized.

claims.statement: 1953년 환화 1억3486만8300 적자 표시는 최종 확정된 실현 손실이다
claims.conclusion: A/2487 §22 says apparent hwan 134,868,300 deficit from unsettled grain/fertilizer sale receipts and unsettled exchange rate, expected offset; final settlement and actual realization unverified.

claims.statement: 1954년 주택 9,000~9,500호 계획은 1954년에 전부 준공되었다
claims.conclusion: A/2750 §71 combined FY53/54 target 9-9.5k; A/3651 1957 reports total completed >8,300 after FY56/57 4,400+ additional; not 1954 full completion. Compare 1957 revised programme scope before judging underachievement.

claims.statement: 1957년 UNKRA 중소기업 대출 1,381건은 모두 1954년 승인 건이다
claims.conclusion: A/3651 §28 cumulative since August1954 through June1957 1,381 loans (374 FX,1007 local), 1,162 enterprises. A/2750 §45 only initial 1954 board approvals. Do not project 1957 totals backward.

claims.statement: 1957년 문경 시멘트공장은 1954년 계획만으로 이미 완공·가동되었다
claims.conclusion: A/2750 §46 says 1954 contract developing; A/3651 1957 §10 says 89% overall construction, 94.6% machinery arrival, kiln near operation. Later 1957 full commissioning not yet proven.

claims.statement: 1953 UNKRA $70m 연간 지출계획은 그해 전액 약정·지급되었다
claims.conclusion: Audit FY plan $70m, resources $67.796m, plan available $66.649m, obligations $51.818m, payments $26.419m; 5% income shortfall and implementation delay.

claims.statement: 1957 UNKRA 소규모 제조업 금융지원에 고무제품 산업은 포함되지 않았다
claims.conclusion: A/3651 §29 explicitly lists rubber goods among aided small industries, but company names and disbursement outcomes uninspected.

notes: Distinct UN bodies and national delegations are different institutional speakers but UN documentation is one archive family; do not count as three independent archival provenance families.
